facts.fact: Petra 把黑暗远处晃动的红色头灯当成搭档 Jade 或别的潜员，放声呼喊
facts.anchor: Could that be Jade? Or another diver? Either way, it’s someone with a light.

facts.fact: Petra 把小石头扔到 tombstepper 身后、瞄准墙壁让它弹跳作响以引开怪物
facts.anchor: I throw the rock as far as I can behind the tombstepper

facts.fact: Petra 在过窄隧道里被卡住（背包被勾住），靠前后左右扭动才一点点挪动脱身
facts.anchor: I wiggle side to side, then forward and backward.

facts.fact: 孤儿院男孩 Clay 卡死在第二层窄隧道，救援者脱臼其髋关节仍拉不出，他被困 twelve hours 后心搏停止
facts.anchor: the next twelve hours, Clay was trapped, contorted in a hole with broken hips

facts.fact: 搭档 Jade 已取走遇难潜员 Henry 的补给，Petra 从尸体下抽出的背包几乎空、只剩蛋白棒
facts.anchor: almost empty. Jade took his supplies, I remember now.

facts.fact: Petra 见骨饮者吞尸后决定先上地面取新装备并找救援者，再下潜把 Jade 带出来
facts.anchor: I only have one choice left: I have to go back to the surface, get new gear

facts.fact: 带队潜导拒绝把备用灯借给 Petra，只让她自己沿路走回地面
facts.anchor: No, we can’t spare anything, sorry.

facts.fact: 巨蛾的带爪腿勾住 Petra 的背包，开始把她拽离岩壁（该蛾翼展 fifteen-foot）
facts.anchor: The moth’s little grabby legs hook into my backpack
